partnershipPlan: Two technicians and a ward pharmacist review the charting form; a patient partner reviews the plain-language summary for the committee.
socialListening: No social media listening; professional association newsletters are searched as grey literature, not as voices.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I already find most of the discrepancies at admission; I would like to finish the job at discharge.
items.implication: Chart the tasks technicians do in each transition, not just whether they are involved.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I am happy to check flagged items, but I cannot re-do every list.
items.implication: Chart supervision models and pharmacist time.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I went home with my old blood pressure tablet and the new one, and nobody noticed for a week.
items.implication: Record whether any report measured what patients took after discharge.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: What another province allows does not settle what our college allows.
items.implication: Chart jurisdiction and date for every scope statement.

summary: Four composite voices on role readiness, oversight, patient harm and regulatory scope.
